name: Ozaki
source:
"Ah, because I'm a man, I hate staring at you like that."

A mysterious man with a merchant-like appearance.

He always uses honorifics and has a kind demeanor but is somehow unreadable. He's always smiling.

[Translated from [url=https://karakuren.wixsite.com/irohanihoheto/%E4%BA%BA%E7%89%A9-1]offiical website[/url]]
